observation.command:
cd /workspace && rm -f compose_build.log compose_build2.log; echo "=== FINAL SERVICE STATUS ==="; cd deployment && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml ps --format "table {{.Name}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}" 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== Final endpoint checks ==="
for h in "app.localhost /" "api.localhost /api/v1/" "admin.localhost /admin/" "tiles.localhost /data/germany.json"; do d=${h% *}; p=${h#* }; code=$(curl -sk --resolve ${d}:443:127.0.0.1 "https://${d}${p}" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}"); echo "  ${d}${p} -> ${code}"; done
